text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It felt as though the temperature in the waiting room
had dropped several degrees since before the race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the tense atmosphere, Mejiro Ramonu
stands motionless, like a statue of ice.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
choice_data_list: Still, that was a run that builds towards the next one.
Let's get you retrained to perfection.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
We were supposed to burn together, exchanging our passion.
...This is far from a dialogue of love.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
âI will polish myself anew.
So that I may be worthy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "It's helpful that you keep repeating the self-evident."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Cold words only serve
to stir up hot affection...
